sloka: ततः प्रीत्या ऽन्विता देवाः सहस्राक्षं ववन्दिरे ।विज्वरः स च पूतात्मा वासवः समपद्यत ।। ७.८६.१८ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ prītyā 'nvitā devāḥ sahasrākṣaṁ vavandire ।vijvaraḥ sa ca pūtātmā vāsavaḥ samapadyata ।। 7.86.18 ॥

translations.english: Then the gods, filled with joy, saluted the thousand-eyed Indra, and Indra himself became free from distress and purified in soul.
